absolute.source: TCGA PanCanAtlas ABSOLUTE mastercalls (TCGA_mastercalls.abs_tables_JSedit.fixed.txt; Taylor et al., Cancer Cell 2018; method: Carter et al., Nat Biotechnol 2012). Sample key: TCGA-XX-XXXX-01. Rows of all call statuses are kept (absolute_called = 1 for status 'called').

columns.absolute_called: 1 if the ABSOLUTE call status is 'called' (0: legacy / maf / snp calls)
